proof.ticketNamespace: Ticket numbers are scoped per match. The same ticket number can exist in different matches, so matchId plus ticketNumber identifies the winning entry.

notes: This snapshot is produced from one VRF random word at round level.
Each match keeps an independent 1..N ticket namespace.
Each prize slot has one winner and the configured alternate tickets.
Transaction proof rows map reveal transactions back to matchId; finalize/request transactions are round-level proof.
